findings.why: The ASL entry APR-009 still reads approved with no end date. The 8D says the HB-620 approval was revoked on 2026-09-15, which is before today (2026-11-14), so the ASL entry is outdated. Fonderia Dora has no current approval for HB-620 for Nordhavn at Pinerolo, and the proposal to keep ordering from them conflicts with that.
